name: OMNIPRO 220 wire-feed path (expert seed)
note: Hand-checked rules from the OMNIPRO 220 owner manual. Every quote below is verbatim manual text (owner-manual p10 spool setup, p42 MIG/Flux-Cored troubleshooting). Rules are resolved by entity NAME at compile time, unique match only: if the canonical model has two entities with the same name, the rule is skipped and the compile warnings say so, never guessed.

rules.description: Troubleshooting p42, problem 'Wire Feed Motor Runs but Wire Does Not Feed Properly', possible cause 4: 'Feed Tensioner is too tight'.

evidence.quote: Wire Feed Motor Runs but Wire Does Not Feed Properly

rules.name: Feed tensioner too tight stops wire feed

rules.description: Troubleshooting p42, likely solution 4 for the same problem: 'Loosen Feed Tensioner so it applies only enough pressure to prevent continued spinning after the Gun Trigger is released.'

evidence.quote: Loosen Feed Tensioner so it applies only enough pressure to prevent continued spinning after the Gun Trigger is released.

rules.name: Correct feed tension restores wire feed

rules.description: Spool loading notice p10: 'If Wire Spool can spin freely, Wingnut is too loose. This will cause the welding wire to unravel and unspool which can cause tangling and feeding problems.'

evidence.quote: If Wire Spool can spin freely, Wingnut is too loose. This will cause the welding wire to unravel and unspool which can cause tangling and feeding problems.

rules.name: Loose wingnut lets the spool spin freely

rules.description: Spool loading p10 step 5: 'Replace the Spacer over the Spool Spindle and secure Spool in place with the Wingnut.'

evidence.quote: Replace the Spacer over the Spool Spindle and secure Spool in place with the Wingnut.

rules.name: Tightening the wingnut stops the spool spinning freely
